Subject: SIG/CAIQ review for NebulaWorks — request to schedule preflight

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for the quick responses during the RFP — NebulaWorks would like to move forward with a focused SIG + CAIQ preflight call to align on scope and artifacts. Two quick asks up front: 1) Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a CAIQ-export or do you prefer we work from the CAIQ PDF? 2) High-level list of log / sampling windows you can provide for audit review.

Would you be available for a 60-minute call next week (my team's timezone PST)? We can do: Tue 4/6 10:00am PT or Wed 4/7 2:00pm PT. Please confirm a slot and any initial pre-reads you want us to review.

Thanks — Elena
Elena Park
Head of Security, NebulaWorks
elena.park@nebulaworks.com

Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ review for NebulaWorks — request to schedule preflight

Hi Elena — great to hear from you. Thanks for the options; Wed 4/7 2:00pm PT works best for our team. We'll plan for a 60-minute session.

Answers to your two quick asks:
- CAIQ: We can provide a machine-readable CAIQ export (json + PDF summary). I'll attach the CAIQ-summary and a short coverage matrix after our internal prep.
- Logs: we can provide 30-day rolling access to request logs and a 90-day sample for audit purposes; for ingestion/egress traces we typically supply a 14-day sample window. We'll confirm exact retention slices during the call.

Irene (security lead) and Ben (solutions) are looped for artifact owners and to prep the demo of the dataflow diagram.

Agenda (proposed):
1) Intros & scope confirmation (5m)
2) CAIQ coverage review approach (10m)
3) Artifact map & ownership (10m)
4) Log sampling and retention clarification (15m)
5) Q&A / open questions (15m)
6) Next steps & owners (5m)

Can you share any high-priority CAIQ questions or SIG rows you want to surface ahead of time? If you confirm the time I'll send the calendar invite and a short pre-read link.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Security Program Manager, Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0123

Thanks Sofia — Wed 4/7 2:00pm PT confirmed (calendar invite received). Appreciate the agenda. A couple of quick follow-ups so we can triage internally before the call:

1) Please include any SOC 2 scope statement and whether you run an external SOC 2 audit or internal.
2) For log samples — if possible we prefer redacted JSON lines with timestamps and non-identifying request metadata.

We'll surface our top 10 CAIQ rows of interest in a shared doc by EOD tomorrow. Post-call, our procurement lead (cc'd later) will request the evidence bundle + any additional attestation language.

Attachments to expect from your side (per your note) — please confirm when you share: SIG-Coverage-Matrix.xlsx; CAIQ-summary.pdf; redwood-dataflow-diagram.png.

See you on Wednesday — Elena
